name: elevenlabs
summary: Completed the ElevenLabs quickstart end-to-end. Installed the `elevenlabs` and `python-dotenv` packages, created the example script using the provided API key from the environment, and successfully generated an MP3 audio file from the text "The first move is what sets everything in motion." The output file `output.mp3` (43KB) was verified as a valid MPEG ADTS Layer III audio file at 128 kbps, 44.1 kHz, mono — matching the requested `mp3_44100_128` format.
deviations: The quickstart example uses `play(audio)` to stream audio through speakers. Since the sandbox is headless with no audio output hardware, I saved the returned audio iterator to a file (`output.mp3`) instead. This is the only deviation; all other steps (installing the SDK, loading the API key from environment, making the text-to-speech request with the same voice_id, model_id, and output_format) followed the quickstart exactly.

configured.evidence: python example.py exited 0 and produced audio, proving valid credentials were present

verified.evidence: output.mp3: Audio file with ID3 version 2.4.0, contains: MPEG ADTS, layer III, v1, 128 kbps, 44.1 kHz, Monaural
